reuse.why: Puts the option into the existing getBulkBudgetCategories selection helper that five month-wide actions share, rather than filtering at each action.

duplication.why: The hidden rule stays in one SQL fragment; the only repetition is the inline `{ month; includeHiddenCategories? }` argument type restated in five signatures instead of one shared type.

placement.why: The flag is handled in the shared category query in budget/actions.ts, where the exclusion rules already live.

scope.why: Only the flag, its plumbing through the actions and one test.

maintainability.why: Clean for the actions that use the helper, but copyPreviousMonth, also a month-wide action, keeps its own hidden/template/#fixed checks over getBudgetData and does not get the flag, so the rule remains split and now inconsistent between actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff routes the flag through getBulkBudgetCategories; copyPreviousMonth's pre-existing separate filtering (actions.ts) is left untouched rather than newly bypassing.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated by the diff; the repeated parameter type is plain.
